reason: The direction is right: compare arm with a same-recipe control, not with the leaky public weights. But the gate as written does not remove the traps it claims to remove, and it cannot decide items of the planned size. (1) LEAK STAYS THROUGH THE INIT. Every planned training item (D program, I-113/I-110, coordhead-v2 on primary features) fine-tunes from pilkwang weights or uses their features, and those saw all 199 videos. CONTEXT l.235-240 already found that 'LOEO (fine-tuned on 6bba, but base saw 44b6)' is memorised. So arm and control both leak, and changes that stay close to the init (ignore-unlabelled loss, fewer effective steps) are favoured on the memorised held-out embryo. Only from-scratch training on one embryo is leak-free, at ~1.3 GPU-h per epoch x 5+ epochs per model (the scratch secondary scored 0.920, a different operating point). (2) SEED NOISE SWAMPS THE EFFECTS. The measured fine-tune seed variance is +-0.005 (seed 7 0.9502 vs seed 42 0.9575; CONTEXT l.88/167/252, RESULTS l.78). The expected effects are about the same size: D +0.006..+0.009, coordhead 0..+0.002, I-079 0..+0.004. The pass rule (sign in both directions + 6bba clip-bootstrap LB > 0) ignores training-seed variance, and 'same seeds' does not keep GPU training runs paired once the loss or target changes. So one seed pair passes or fails by luck. Resolving +0.006 needs ~9 seeds per arm per direction, and +0.002 needs ~75, which is ~10x or more the stated '+4-8 GPU-h'. (3) The 44b6-train direction (71 overlapping crops of ONE recording, ~1% annotated, 26 divisions; F-DAT-01/03) gives a weak model, so requiring 'delta > 0 in both directions' is close to a coin flip on that leg. (4) The premise is shaky. F-MOD-05's kill was diagnosed as learning 6bba's annotation z-offset, which is an embryo shift, and F-TRN-05 shows the TTA failures were embryo difference, not memorisation. That shift is exactly what matters for the private embryos. The deploy decision (our model vs the public weights) is still made against the leaky baseline and is not answered by arm-minus-control. (5) Value and schedule: it has no LB or private effect before 29 Sep (curator text only; R8 does not apply), and it duplicates G0 (ii) of r12p-2 in the same scan.
fix: Do not add it as a separate item. Fold an amended version into r12p-2 G0 (ii) / LESSONS s4: (a) declare the init per item. A fine-tune from pilkwang or dorado weights is labelled 'leak-residual' and can support only a no-harm or learning claim. A score-lever claim needs a from-scratch pair on one embryo. (b) Add an A/A seed null: at least 3 seeds per arm. PASS needs the mean arm-control delta to exceed 2x the control-vs-control seed SD in the 6bba-test direction. Use a bootstrap over clips AND seeds, not clips alone. (c) Make the 44b6-train direction a no-harm check (delta >= -1 seed SD), not a sign requirement. (d) Keep node count within +-1%. (e) Deployment still needs a separate late-submission or private read against the public weights. Budget it honestly at ~3x seeds x 2 directions x 2 arms, about 12 trainings per item.
realistic_gain: 0 on public or private (post-deadline methodology only). As learning: it prevents false-positive 'retrain works' claims, but only with the seed-null amendment, and then at ~10x the stated GPU cost.
